Name: Brushed Bronze Iridium Sprinkler
Author: maerumaer2u
Description:
Ever wished the iridium sprinkler was a little less...bright?  This mod gives the iridium sprinkler a mellow, brushed bronze finish so it won't clash with the rest of your farm.

Installation is simple: simply unzip the file into your Mods folder and you're good to go!

[b]Compatibility
[/b]This mod is not immediately compatible with any other mod that edits the appearance of the iridium sprinkler.  If you use another mod that does this and experience problems where neither edit applies, post a comment and I'll be back to you ASAP.
